justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/modules/ModuleOpensDirective.java` plus `ModuleDirective.java` and sibling `ModuleExportsDirective.java`. `ModuleOpensDirective` is small (210 lines), has only 2 state fields (`name`, `moduleNames`), and its methods are mostly generated AST boilerplate: constructor wiring, visitor/clone hooks, property accessors, type-casting helpers, and meta-model access. The only custom logic is narrow node removal/replacement for those two fields, so there is no evidence of multiple separable responsibilities or a class that needs further decomposition.
